elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 unconditionally requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000, satisfying the conditional requirement.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 requires HDI to provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing the coverage on request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback minimum.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 5,000,000 cyber and privacy liability limit exceeds the USD 2,000,000 fallback minimum.
